mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_feedback (id, task_id, child_id, doctor_id, core_problem_clarity, judgment_improvement, observation_accuracy, suggestions, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{childId}, #{doctorId}, #{coreProblemClarity}, #{judgmentImprovement}, #{observationAccuracy}, #{suggestions}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assessment_feedback WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assessment_feedback WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_feedback SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_deleted = 0
